additional_info.subject: ID0467699-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P7 312547889/01] Terminal Issue CRM:03288000002
additional_info.body:
Dear Romain,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
After carefully checking the errors and logs in the charger, we have identified the problem.
We can try to solve this problem by performing a soft reboot to the charger, but at the moment the charger is being occupied.
We can only perform a soft reboot when the charger is not in use, this reboot takes around 10 minutes.
If this reboot doesn`t solve the problem, we will hand the case over to our colleauges to further investigate the problem.
Please let us know when we are able to perform this reboot to the charger.
Thank you.
Best regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
eMobility Technical Support Team
